verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a first-party API for programmatic control, along with access tokens and a Terraform provider for configuration as code, so the core of API-driven operation exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and the Connector Builder is described as part of the UI. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API feature parity, evidence that Connector Builder and AI Assistant work through the API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Airbyte API to programmatically interact with Airbyte. For example, you can control Airbyte in conjunction with orchestration tools like Airflow.
Most programmatic interactions with Airbyte require an access token.
you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code
